exposure: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy or postpartum
cohort: 597 pregnant and puerperal women with SARS-CoV-2 infection admitted to ICUs in Turkey between March 1, 2020, and January 1, 2022
finding: Severe/critical COVID-19 infection during the pregnancy/puerperal period was associated with high maternal mortality and fetal/neonatal complication rates in Turkey.
mod_finding: Severe/critical COVID-19 infection during the pregnancy/puerperal period was associated with high rates of cesarean section (53.7%).
